description: Canonical brownfield improve-existing-website interview/inspection state machine.

transitions.condition: Another unresolved dimension remains (up to limit)
User approves scope; material redesign explicitly approved

interruption_resume.behavior: Resume from last completed state; re-read preserved signals before continuing

evidence_inference.rule: Every claim about the existing system must carry exactly one label: EVIDENCE (directly observed) or INFERRED (derived from patterns). Never omit the label.

preserved_signals.description: Brand signals that must survive improvement — do not erase without user approval

readiness_outputs.high: Proceed with targeted improvements; no material redesign
readiness_outputs.medium: Ask at most 3 clarifying questions before proceeding
readiness_outputs.low: Surface a scope decision; material redesign requires explicit approval

question_constraints.question_format: Each question must name the unresolved dimension and explain why the answer changes the implementation

no_question_path.condition: Evidence + inferences are sufficient to proceed without ambiguity
no_question_path.behavior: Proceed directly to approve state; state what was inferred

material_redesign.definition: Changes that alter the visual identity, structural layout, or brand voice beyond incremental improvement
material_redesign.approval_format: State the proposed scope change, present alternatives, wait for user confirmation before proceeding
